details.note: Look at error rates, failed checkouts and support tickets, not hunches. Spend five minutes at most.
The journeys that matter most. Name your own: booking, payment, upload.
Most customers can't complete a core journey. Respond within 5 minutes, day or night.
The incident lead runs the response and the comms; the on-call engineer fixes.
Any customer seeing errors, slowness or wrong data counts. A suspected breach also goes to the security on-call.
Some customers affected with no workaround, or data at risk. Respond within 15 minutes, day or night.
Minor, or there's a workaround. Fix in working hours; no one is woken up.
